recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-50863. Revisit only if the work group later resolves FHIR-55447 or another tracker to change the broader version policy for resourceDefinition on core resources.
issue_request: FHIR-50863 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for FHIR-core BaseResource. It asked what should happen to the JSON resourceDefinition property and XML resourceDefinition attribute when an additional resource moves into core. The final decision was that resourceDefinition is no longer needed once the resource is a standard core resource, may remain for backwards compatibility, SHOULD NOT be added, and if present SHALL have a version correct for the published core FHIR version.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 09b9a4c718f6db95ad354a42fede0090b80dfce8, which added the migration rule only to source/resource/resource-introduction.xml. The original additional-resource support came from 931df6ae329dd3d7f44df8358b5affdd2b95e757. source/json.html and source/xml.html still said resourceDefinition is not present whenever the resource/resourceType is defined in this specification, leaving the format pages inconsistent with the applied migration rule.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2025-07-21 confirm the 12-0-0 vote and rationale: when a resource is promoted to core, resourceDefinition is not needed, but the group did not want to say it must be absent; if present, its version must be corrected to the core FHIR version. FHIR-55447 later submitted a broader request about allowing resourceDefinition to point to normative or trial-use versions of core resources, but that issue is unresolved and does not change this applied rule.
reconciliation: Updated source/resource/resource-introduction.xml to refer precisely to the JSON property and XML attribute and state that it is no longer needed after promotion to core. Updated source/json.html and source/xml.html so their otherwise-not-present rule includes the approved exception for resources that moved from additional-resource status into core, including the SHOULD NOT add and SHALL correct-version requirements.
source_changes: source/resource/resource-introduction.xml: clarified that moved-to-core resourceDefinition is a JSON property or XML attribute, no longer needed, allowed to remain for backwards compatibility, and SHOULD NOT be added.
source/json.html: added the moved-additional-resource exception to the JSON resourceDefinition not-present rule and retained the correct core-version requirement.
source/xml.html: added the moved-additional-resource exception to the XML resourceDefinition not-present rule and retained the correct core-version requirement.
